items.title: First line hits
items.content:
First line hitsImran Raz (@Imran_Razaq)It's almost like whoever missed the AI wave is turning into a doomer. Maybe most people don't realize that we're still in the early stages. I worked in consulting, and many Fortune 500 companies are still using systems that are over 20 years old, with outdated software. Building a data pipeline still takes about 9 months. “Adoption of AI” is measured by how many company employees are using ChatGPT 😂

We're still in the beginning.—  https://x.com/Imran_Razaq/status/2089508370906534347 
— Chris Camillo (@ChrisCamillo) Aug 18, 2026
